notes: Account snapshot: Verdant Pulse AI builds edge-to-cloud crop-health assistants — low-latency decisioning (alerts + short summaries) across distributed sensor fleets. Evaluating Redwood Dedicated for predictable per-region throughput and a private connectivity option.
Primary ask: throughput guarantees and clear burst policy. They want a committed baseline per-region (min tokens/sec) with documented concurrency caps and defined automatic fallback behavior.

Target numbers discussed (customer asks):
- Baseline sustained: 12,000 tokens/sec per NA region
- Concurrency limit: up to 100 concurrent streaming sessions (avg completion ~256 tokens)
- Burst: up to 30,000 tokens/sec for 60 seconds allowed before graceful throttling or fallback
- Latency SLOs: 95th percentile per-completion (256 tokens) < 2s; per-token tail < 250ms (goal)

Redwood POC summary (SE Evan Cho ran tests 2026-02-20):
- Load test id: loadtest-verdant-2026-02-20 (k6 + custom streaming harness)
- Config used: 8xA100-equivalent GPUs, aggressive batching + KV prefix caching, int8 quantization model variant
- Observed sustained throughput: ~14k tokens/sec regionally with average p95 completion time 1.6s for 256-token completions
- Burst handling: system tolerated short bursts to ~28k tokens/sec before queueing increased; recommendation: explicit burst window + documented throttling behavior
- Notes: caching of repeated sensor prefixes gave 2.5x effective throughput for many flows — potential to lower committed baseline if caching exploited.

Commercial asks & negotiation points:
- Customer wants a minimum tokens/sec guarantee in contract (will tie to credits/penalty). We proposed a tiered guarantee: baseline + burst pool (metered).
- They require hard concurrency caps per-customer (to prevent noisy neighbors) and an explicit policy for failover to quantized model or degraded SLA when exceeded.
- Request for a 60- to 90-day ramp window for reserved GPUs; want options to scale reserved capacity up quarterly.

Security / deployment notes:
- Preference for VPC Private deployment with optional airgap for sensitive farms.
- Need KMS integration for key management and audit logging retention 24 months.
- Data residency: primary NA region only for regulatory customers (must document region pinning).
